<function name="GetOrigin" parent="CMoveData" type="classfunc">
	<description>Gets the player's position.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Vector">The player's position.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>

	<code>
